title: Portal elevator like vertical blinds?
content: This sub randomly showed up in my feed, and I'm shocked and amazed it exists. I've been dreaming of a mall for many years, and one of the features is an elevator to a hidden lower level that only opens up occasionally, and isn't visible to everyone else in the mall. You stand sideways next to a wall, and the elevator door opens up like vertical blinds. You slide into it like you're on a conveyor belt. In my dream, it's in a particular section of the mall I went to as a kid, the section with the movie theater. The elevator is right across from the theater. If anyone else has experienced this, I'll be stunned and amazed.
